base.html:
Can you alphabetize a cloud?

Certainly. First, separate the vowels from the weather.

My spreadsheet has become a small forest.

Try watering column B. Avoid feeding the formulas after midnight.

Please summarize this invisible sandwich.

Two slices of possibility, with a generous layer of perhaps.

How many tabs can a Tuesday hold?

Approximately twelve, unless the calendar is buffering.

Write a very quiet thunderstorm.

The clouds switched to lowercase. nobody noticed the rain.

My robot keeps dreaming in italics.

Turn the pillow ninety degrees and restart the moon.

base.javascript: (()=>{const chat=document.querySelector('.chat-background');const pause=chat.querySelector('.chat-pause');pause.addEventListener('click',()=>{const paused=chat.classList.toggle('paused');pause.setAttribute('aria-pressed',String(paused));pause.textContent=paused?'Resume chat':'Pause chat';});const frame=document.querySelector('.project-frame iframe');const title=document.getElementById('frame-project-name');const open=document.getElementById('open-project');const books=[...document.querySelectorAll('.book')];books.forEach(book=>book.addEventListener('click',event=>{if(event.ctrlKey||event.metaKey||event.shiftKey||event.altKey||event.button!==0)return;books.forEach(link=>link.removeAttribute('aria-current'));book.setAttribute('aria-current','true');const name=book.textContent.trim();title.textContent=name;open.setAttribute('href',book.getAttribute('href'));frame.title=name+' project page';}));const stage=document.querySelector('.portrait-stage');const poses=[...stage.querySelectorAll('img')];const reduced=window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)');let pending=false,last=null;function show(name,mirror=false){poses.forEach(image=>{const active=image.dataset.pose===name;image.classList.toggle('active',active);image.style.transform=active&&mirror?'scaleX(-1)':'';});}function update(){pending=false;if(!last||reduced.matches){show('neutral');return;}const rect=stage.getBoundingClientRect();const dx=last.x-(rect.left+rect.width/2);const dy=last.y-(rect.top+rect.height/2);if(Math.hypot(dx,dy)<65){show('neutral');return;}const vertical=Math.abs(dy)>Math.abs(dx)*1.55;let pose;if(vertical)pose=dy<0?'up':'down';else if(Math.abs(dy)>Math.abs(dx)*.38)pose=dy<0?'up-right':'down-right';else pose='right';show(pose,!vertical&&dx<0);}document.addEventListener('pointermove',event=>{if(event.pointerType==='touch')return;last={x:event.clientX,y:event.clientY};if(!pending){pending=true;requestAnimationFrame(update);}});document.documentElement.addEventListener('pointerleave',()=>{last=null;show('neutral');});window.addEventListener('blur',()=>{last=null;show('neutral');});reduced.addEventListener('change',update);})();
